span.p:
Current Python protocol: only definition() and analyze().
Plugins are stateless; parameters travel in AnalysisContext.params.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Catalog registers ma_cross@v1 and ema_cross@v1.
No BaseStrategy or MAStrategy class exists.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Registry marker composite@v1; analyze() returns HOLD.
Child resolution and combination live in DeterministicEngine.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
catalog.py register_all(): ma/ema, RSI, Bollinger,
support_resistance, smc BOS, news_sentiment, MACD, composite.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Precompute once, then causal CausalCandles + IndicatorView per index.
Optional requirements(params) overrides static metadata.
